'''Li'Dali''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief security]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Inrokini family]] living on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]]. In [[3629 BBY]] the ruling [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] harbored a fugitive from the [[Eternal Alliance]] named [[Theron Shan]] on Copero and [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] authorized the Alliance to take action against the rogue Syndic and their traitor. Zenta ordered the soldiers of House Inrokini to stop the intruders, but Li'Dali and her men were killed by [[Raina Temple]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Security Officer Li'Dali appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion as an optional mini-boss during the flashpoint "A Traitor Among the Chiss". Killing her is required for an achievement.
